# PNX — Free Agentic SEO Tool & AI Search Co-Pilot

> PNX is a 100% free agentic SEO platform built by Saboor Tahir. It provides on-page SEO audits, AI keyword research with intent clustering, live SERP competitor analysis, YouTube SEO, and AI content generation.

## Core Pages
- [Homepage](https://pnx.lovable.app/): Overview of PNX tools, comparison with paid suites, and founder mission.
- [PNX Chat](https://pnx.lovable.app/chat): Free AI SEO agent workspace — no daily limits, no signup wall.
- [Blog Index](https://pnx.lovable.app/blog): Free articles on Agentic SEO, GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), technical SEO, and keyword research.
- [About Saboor Tahir](https://pnx.lovable.app/about): Background on PNX founder Saboor Tahir and the mission behind free SEO tools.
- [Contact](https://pnx.lovable.app/contact): Get in touch with Saboor Tahir and the PNX team.
- [FAQ](https://pnx.lovable.app/faq): Frequently asked questions regarding PNX features, free tier policy, and security.
- [Google OAuth Transparency Hub](https://pnx.lovable.app/google-oauth-verification): Full disclosure of Google API integrations, scopes, and Limited Use policy.
